parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA
parsed.notes: Figures are from the reconciliation table, which is in thousands. The narrative gives matching rounded amounts: $79.8 million (19.4% of revenue) for Q3 2026 versus $78.5 million in Q3 2025. The excerpt has no year-to-date adjusted EBITDA. The boilerplate text refers to quarters ended June 30, but the table covers the three months ended September 30.
